Chapter 400: Chapter 14 Fool! (Please subscribe)

This session of the Seven Star Cave examination really did bring forth many geniuses.

There were thirteen Red Pattern Challengers alone, and nearly a thousand Golden Pattern Challengers.

You must know, whether it’s Red Patternn or Golden Pattern, they are all personally recognized by the Chikun Star Lord, although it cannot represent their full potential.

But to become a Red Pattern, at the very least the unveiled talent and potential definitely ranks at the very top of all the challengers.

And at this moment.

Under the watchful eyes of Lin Yuan and various Peak Masters.

...

Challengers, filled with vigor, continuously made their way through layer after layer of star caves, heading toward the ultimate Seventh Star Cave.

“That Red Pattern Challenger must have awakened some special Fire System bloodline, with not low potential, does anyone want him?” Third Senior Brother’s eyes shone as he asked.

“You can have him.”

“I don’t follow the Fire System rules.”

“Special bloodline, eh? It looks like it should be one of those superior Fire System bloodlines…”

The Peak Masters started to speak one after another.

Lin Yuan also took a careful look at that Red Pattern Challenger.

“Indeed not bad.”

Lin Yuan nodded to himself.

Although Lin Yuan didn’t have any special bloodline, he had to admit that a superior bloodline physique truly provided significant help in cultivation.

Especially in the early stages, a superior bloodline could even achieve victory over those at higher ranks.

“Since Third Senior Brother wants him, I won’t compete…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. For Lin Yuan, it was only based on the suggestion of the Chikun Star Lord that he planned to take in a few challengers.

As for who exactly, that was not yet determined, to compete with brothers over a mere challenger? Lin Yuan felt it was unnecessary.

“I wonder if this time in the Seven Star Cave World, anyone will pass the ultimate challenge?” Second Senior Brother said with a nostalgic tone, casually mentioning it.

The so-called ultimate challenge was to comprehend the barest trace of the ‘Mysterious Yellow’ Evolution Path. It was by achieving this that the Chikun Star Lord, who was in seclusion and not to be disturbed, took the initiative to come out of seclusion and personally accepted Lin Yuan as the thirteenth disciple.

You should know, before this, the Chikun Star Lord had not taken a disciple for ten thousand years, ordinary challengers, even if they were Red Patterns, could not catch the eye of the Chikun Star Lord.

With the talents of a Red Pattern Challenger, at most they could hope to advance to the Sixth Rank, while every disciple taught by the Chikun Star Lord starts from the Sixth Rank.

“The ultimate challenge?”

“Our Red Kun Lineage, in ten thousand years, only had junior brother emerge.”

“Now to expect another one? How is that possible?”

“Right, what do these challengers have to compare to junior brother?”

…

The twelve Peak Masters casually chatted, under a hundred years old Seventh Rank Evolvers were rare, not to mention in the Chikun Star Domain, even the entire Annan Star Alliance had only seen a few.

How could there be two emerging in the Chikun Star Domain consecutively?

Lin Yuan listened to his senior brothers chatting, occasionally chiming in.

“Eldest senior brother, when do you plan to go to the star domains outside to be stationed?” Fourth Senior Brother Zuo Ge asked softly.

The eldest senior brother, having stepped into the Eighth Layer, needed to fulfill the obligations of human civilization, stationing in a star domain for five hundred years.

This star domain, naturally, is not the star domains within human civilization, but recently developed fringe star domains.

The Human Civilization Alliance is constantly expanding, and with that, the territory of human civilization is continuously growing.

The star domains where Eighth Rank Evolvers are required to station are the newly occupied territories of human civilization.

In these territories, the main enemies are definitely quelled by the powerhouses of human civilization, but there still remain some residual tribal forces.

It then depends on the decision of the Star Lords stationed in these star domains, whether to leave these residual forces and integrate them into human civilization or continue to quell them, it all depends on the will of the Star Lord.

Each Star Lord’s governance philosophy differs, some Star Lords wish for all Ten Thousand Universe Races to coexist in harmony, while others believe that those of different species inherently carry different hearts.

“After this session of the Seven Star Cave examination has passed, I will set out.” The Eldest Senior Brother said.

The edge of human civilization territory, not without danger, but an Eighth Rank Evolver is no easy prey,

To completely kill an Eighth Rank Evolver? Difficult to accomplish, and by the Eighth Rank, they typically have Avatars.

To encourage Eighth Rank Evolvers to be stationed at Fringe Starfields, the Supreme Beings of human civilization long ago made promises, that any Evolver who died at the hands of Different Species within the five hundred years of their station would be given ‘Resurrection’.

Tens of thousands of years ago, the star domain Chikun Star Lord was stationed at was indeed the boundary star domain of human civilization.

It’s just that after many years of expansion, the Chikun Star Domain which was on the edge of the territory is now within the core of human civilization territory.

…

Time passed.

One after another, the challengers finally entered the Seventh Star Cave and began to comprehend the more than one hundred stone statues wholeheartedly.

And after observations along the way, Lin Yuan and the other Peak Masters had roughly made their choices among the challengers.

For the Peak Masters, it was only when selecting Red Pattern Challengers that they would announce to each other, with the thirteen Red Pattern Challengers matching perfectly for the thirteen Peak Masters, one for each.

As for Golden Pattern and Silver Pattern Challengers? They hardly made any greetings, because the numbers of Golden and Silver Pattern were too vast.

If by a slim chance, two Peak Masters chose the same Golden Pattern, they would let the Golden Pattern Challenger decide themselves which Peak Master to join.

Of course, if they encountered some special Golden Pattern Challengers, there would be a Peak Master speaking up beforehand, but this situation was rare.

Ordinarily, the hopes for Golden Pattern Challengers to step into the Sixth Rank were much smaller than those of Red Pattern Challengers.

“Junior brother, have you made your choice?” Second Senior Brother curiously looked at Lin Yuan.
